notes.title: Massive Auries Fusion! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello Aurians!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102310/a9a29edc67b177b42c6f82d47660478d0d170533.png[/img]

[h1] Massive Auries Fusion! [/h1]

Now, in Auries Clicker, you can merge multiple Auries at once! Previously, you were limited to merging only 4 at a time, but that has changed! With this new update, you can merge as many as you want at once! 🚀

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Avoid Performance Issues [/h2]

[b]We recommend merging a maximum of 100 Auries at a time[/b] to prevent performance issues... But here’s a challenge: who can merge the most without crashing their PC? 😆 Let us know how far your game lasted before turning into a slideshow! 😂

[hr][/hr]

[h2] The Power of Community Feedback [/h2]

This improvement was only possible thanks to the [b]amazing feedback from the community[/b]. The game wouldn’t have even a fraction of its current features without you!

[b]Special thanks to the users for the suggestion:[/b]
[list]
[]@[G]Manlove
[]@Skaery
[*]@Mixxiphoid
[/list]

For suggesting this improvement. You guys are awesome! 🙌

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Keep Sending Your Suggestions! [/h2]

We want to make Auries Clicker more fun and addictive! Keep sending suggestions and sharing your ideas!

[hr][/hr]

[b]Thanks,[/b] JOZGamer.

notes.title: Correção do Save e Novo Suporte a Segundo Plano
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Auryeans![/h1] 🌟

We have two important updates to share with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102310/a9a29edc67b177b42c6f82d47660478d0d170533.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🛠️ Save System Fix[/h2]
I fixed an issue with the save system that caused files to overwrite each other, leading to conflicts. Now, saves should work properly, ensuring no progress is lost.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔄 Background Mode Functionality[/h2]
This update happened in an unexpected way! The game running in the background was actually an unknown bug. While working on the task system, I accidentally fixed it.

Since this feature had been in the game for a long time and was well-received by the community, I decided to properly reprogram it using the Windows API. Now, the game can run in the background natively and more stably!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Community Feedback[/h2]
Your feedback is essential! Try out the changes and let me know what you think. Aurye Clicker wouldn't have half of its features without the amazing participation of the community.

If you have suggestions or notice anything unusual, leave a comment!

Thanks,
JOZGamer 🎮

notes.title: Tasks Update
notes.content:
[h1]🖱️🎮 New Task System - More Damage for Your Devices! 🔥[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102310/2f65d335bcff7411e953cf996dbd2e28a5236ed7.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Auryeans![/h2]  

The [b]new task system[/b] has arrived, bringing dynamic challenges to [u]boost the damage[/u] of your devices – keyboard, mouse, and gamepad!  

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔥 How does it work?[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 🖥️ [b]Keyboard:[/b] Press specific keys a certain number of times (e.g., [i]press the "T" key 4 times, then 16, then 64...[/i]).  
[*] 🎮 [b]Gamepad:[/b] Use any button or move the analog sticks to complete tasks!  
[*] 🖱️ [b]Mouse:[/b] Click the buttons, move the cursor, or spin the scroll wheel to complete challenges!  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📈 Infinite Progression![/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Tasks start with [b]4 interactions[/b] and multiply by [b]4[/b] ([i]4, 16, 64, 256...[/i]).  
[*] Each interaction has its [b]own counter[/b].  
[*] [u]No limit[/u] to max damage or the number of times you can repeat a task!  
[*] Tasks are [b]randomly selected[/b] at the start of the game and after completing each goal for each device.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]

[h2]❓ Have questions?[/h2]  
If you have any questions about the new system or any other game mechanics, [b]feel free to ask![/b] I'm always here to help.  

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Your feedback is essential![/h2]  
Aurye Clicker has come this far thanks to you! Player feedback has been key to the game’s growth and will [b]keep it evolving[/b].  

Many of the features in the game today exist because of ideas and suggestions from the community. Without you, the game wouldn’t have [b]half[/b] of the features it has now!  

So, [u]keep sharing your opinions, suggestions, and even criticisms[/u] – every comment helps improve the experience for everyone!  

[hr][/hr]

[b]Enjoy the game and keep clicking![/b]  

[b]Thank you, JozGamer[/b]

notes.title: Improvement in the Fusion System: Greater Security and Precision!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Aurians! ✨[/h1]

To ensure an even more stable and reliable experience, we have implemented an important improvement in the item fusion system. Now, the inventory will be temporarily locked while the fusion is being processed. This change prevents the system from getting confused and causing issues such as negative values or false-positive fusions. 🔄

[h2]Benefits of the Change ✅[/h2]

[list]
[*] Prevents inventory inconsistencies 📦  
[*] Ensures better system performance ⚙️  
[*] Increases player security 🔒  
[/list]

[h2]Your Feedback is Essential! 💬[/h2]

The community's opinion is fundamental to the growth of the game! Your feedback and suggestions not only help improve the experience but also contribute to creating new possibilities for all players!

If you encounter any issues or have ideas to further improve the game, leave a comment or post in the community. 💡

Thanks,  
[b]JOZGamer[/b] 🎮

notes.title: 4:3 Aspect Ratio and

notes.title: Inventory fix and fullscreen/window toggle button added
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Auryans![/h1]

In this update, I made two minor improvements to the game:

Thank you, @Saltstorm Jake, @Mia, and @PuriPuriPurple, for reporting the issue with the inventory!

Thank you for your support,
JOZGamer

notes.title: Fusion Update
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Fusion Update ✨[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102310/384c2046162dfa0b47d740d19891c786d46dcffb.png[/img]

[h2]⚡ Explore the New Fusion System[/h2]

You can now finally give purpose to the hundreds of duplicate Auryes you’ve accumulated in your collection!

[list][*] Combine four identical Auryes to create a higher-class one or generate a new entity;
[*] Experiment with unique combinations and uncover rare and surprising results;
[*] Finally complete your collection without relying solely on luck![/list]

[h2]📖 Bestiary Improvements[/h2]

The Bestiary is now more complete than ever! 🐾

[list][*] View all the available entities for the Auryes you’ve discovered;
[*] Track your collection more precisely and explore all the possibilities of the new fusion system.[/list]

[h2]💌 Developer's Note: JOZGamer[/h2]

Hello, Aurye community,

I’d like to share a bit of my journey as a developer and the challenges I faced during the creation and evolution of this game.

When I launched the game, I made a critical mistake: I developed an essential function for the game’s economy based on something that only worked in the developer’s environment. This led to a lot of justified criticism at launch because the game simply didn’t work as it should for you, the players.

This period was extremely difficult for me. I spent more than 72 hours almost without sleep trying to fix the issue and make the game minimally functional. However, it was in vain, as the game’s economy had already been completely compromised. This experience deeply affected me, especially as I was already dealing with financial, personal, and professional challenges.

The pressure was so overwhelming that I fell into a deep depression. I reached a point where I couldn’t see a way out and made an extreme decision. My neighbor saw me and saved my life. After that, I spent two months in a psychiatric clinic. Upon returning home, I faced a period of disorientation, insomnia, and uncertainty about the future.

On top of everything, the game was an undeniable commercial failure. Despite that, I decided to invest even more money into the project simply because of my love for game development. Creating games has always been my passion, and even amidst financial difficulties, I chose to keep improving something I truly believe in.

After a lot of internal and external struggles, I managed to get back on track and refocus on the game. With dedication and learning, I implemented the fusion feature that was essential to the game’s economy. Today, I’m happy to say it’s here, working as it should, and I hope you enjoy this experience to the fullest.

I deeply thank the community that believed in and waited, even during the toughest times. You are part of this journey and the reason I kept fighting.

If you’ve made it this far, thank you so much for reading. I’m always open to hearing your feedback and suggestions, as they’re fundamental for us to keep evolving together.

[h2]💬 Your Feedback Matters![/h2]

If you’ve made it this far, thank you so much for reading. I’m always open to hearing your feedback and suggestions, as they’re fundamental for us to keep evolving together.

With gratitude,
JOZGamer
